reviews.text: Absolutely exceptional clinic, very attentive and caring professionals with our animals. Highly recommended!
Amazing! Dr. Marta, Dr. Filipa, Dr. Sofia, and the whole team! There's no problem they can't solve! Thank you for everything and for all the care you give our furry friends!

Very attentive and professional, and above all, they are never late for appointments. I recommend them.

I've always envied people who had an uncle or other relative who was a veterinarian. That way, every trip to the vet wouldn't be a drama or a game of Russian roulette, because we knew our animals would be in good hands.

That's what I feel has happened to me since I discovered this clinic. That the doctors aren't just doctors, but family. Our family.

And that's what matters.

What a wonderful clinic! We recently moved to a different area, so we decided to change clinics. Unfortunately, there was a reason: my dog ​​ate part of a toy and became poisoned. The specialists immediately invited me to the clinic after a phone call, even though it was lunchtime. I arrived, they quickly examined my dog, did an ultrasound, took blood tests, and convinced me to keep her at the clinic, as they had taken my dog ​​to another clinic for x-rays. They performed all the necessary procedures on my dog, literally saving her from death! I trust these doctors very much; I consider them veterinarians with a capital "V"! Thank you so much! From now on, all my animals, two dogs and a cat, will be seen at this clinic!

Dr. Marta and the rest of the team are fantastic! This is the third time Billy has needed urgent medical attention, and the team's availability, affection, willingness, and care are truly commendable. Thank you for taking such good care of Billy!
The care and love they show our dog is just something special and our boy feels the same about them! Filipa and her team are wonderful; we feel very fortunate to have such an practice nearby.
